articles.title: The key races to watch for the 2026 election
articles.snippet: While crypto isn't a major issue in the 2026 election, the industry will be shaped by who takes office in January. Here are the main races CoinDesk is tracking.

articles.title: As big bitcoin miners chase AI profits, individuals get another shot at the rewards
articles.snippet: Several companies offer access to bitcoin mining without the hassle of running equipment, but high costs and the 2028 reward halving make profits uncertain.

articles.title: Coinbase leads crypto stock selloff following $6.3B Binance hack
articles.snippet: Circle, Strategy and other crypto-linked stocks fell sharply Friday, a day after Binance disclosed a $6.3 billion security breach.

articles.title: Bitcoin risks worst October in 12 years as tech sell-off spreads to gold
articles.snippet: Bitcoin circled $77,000 as crypto markets navigated US stock-market downside, while the gold price fell to its lowest in a year.

articles.title: Zcash grants group offers $124M compromise as governance backlash grows
articles.snippet: Zcash Community Grants proposed redirecting about $124 million in existing and future funding toward mining rewards, but critics say the plan fails to address governance and accountability concerns.
